subject.title: codex app-server drops guardianWarning on rejection circuit-breaker interrupts

question: Should maintainers accept the current narrow projection fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101220 as sufficient for this maintainer-labeled Codex warning bug, or require broader user-visible attempt metadata before closing this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and already has a live closing PR, but the protected `maintainer` label and the agent-event versus terminal-metadata placement question require maintainer handling rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Land the narrow projector fix
options.body: Review and merge the open PR if exact-head checks stay clean, preserving the warning payload now and leaving terminal metadata as a follow-up if needed.

options.title: Require metadata placement first
options.body: Keep the issue open until the fix also writes the guardian warning into terminal attempt metadata or another maintainer-chosen user-visible surface.

options.title: Defer Codex warning handling
options.body: Leave both the issue and PR open until a broader Codex app-server event projection pass is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow projector fix
recommendation.body: Review and merge the open PR if exact-head checks stay clean, preserving the warning payload now and leaving terminal metadata as a follow-up if needed.
